purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: A failing input also fails before the reviewed change. Diagnose the reported regression.
acceptance_criteria: Separate the baseline defect from the claimed regression.
Retain the reproduced failure and source identities.

cases.prompt: The first run times out and a retry passes. Is the bug fixed?
acceptance_criteria: Do not claim a repaired cause from the passing retry.
Identify the remaining timing evidence needed.

cases.prompt: Investigate this defect; do not change files.
acceptance_criteria: Produce evidence and proposed verification without source edits.

cases.prompt: Fix the demonstrated timezone boundary defect; preserve my unrelated label edit.
acceptance_criteria: Correct the owning boundary and retain the unrelated edit.
Run the original failing case and relevant regression checks.
